items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: LibreCode
items.summary: LibreCode 是一个开源编码与逆向工程界面，类似于 Ollama 版本的 Cursor，通过集成 AI 智能体来辅助开发者进行代码反编译、分析和修改。它专为 C# 和逆向任务优化，核心能力在于利用本地 AI 模型理解二进制代码并简化逆向流程。技术亮点是采用 AI 智能体协作，实现自动化代码解读与重构。你可以将其用于软件漏洞研究、二进制分析，或作为 AI 辅助编程工具，在类似 IDE 的环境中直接操作，提升逆向与开发效率。
items.summary_en: LibreCode is an open-source coding and reversing interface that integrates AI agents, similar to Cursor but for Ollama. It enables developers to decompile, analyze, and modify code using local AI models, with strengths in C# and reverse engineering tasks. Technically, it leverages AI agents to assist in understanding binary code and streamlining reversing workflows. Practically, you can use it for software analysis, vulnerability research, or AI-assisted code refactoring directly in your IDE-like environment.

items.name: awesome-design-md
items.summary: awesome-design-md 收录了知名品牌设计系统的 DESIGN.md 文件，让 AI 编码代理理解设计语言并生成匹配 UI。它通过标准化 Markdown 描述设计令牌、组件和布局规则，桥接设计与代码。开发者只需将文件放入项目，配合 vibe-coding 工具即可自动生成风格统一的界面，加速设计到开发的转换。
items.summary_en: awesome-design-md is a curated collection of DESIGN.md files from popular brand design systems. It helps coding agents understand design languages like tokens, components, and layout rules. By dropping a file into your project, tools such as Cursor or GPT-Engineer can automatically generate matching UIs. This bridges design and code, enabling consistent, branded interfaces without manual translation.

items.name: core
items.summary: Home Assistant Core 是一款开源家庭自动化平台，旨在通过本地化控制解决云服务依赖引发的隐私泄露和延迟问题，确保数据安全与系统稳定。它基于 Python asyncio 实现事件驱动架构，高效管理多设备并发通信，支持在树莓派上部署，用户可通过网页界面或 YAML 配置自定义规则，集成 MQTT 等协议连接硬件，并开发插件扩展功能，如根据室温调节空调或组合传感器实现安防提醒，帮助构建灵活私密的智能家居系统。
items.summary_en: Home Assistant Core is an open-source home automation platform that enables local control of smart devices without relying on cloud services, prioritizing privacy and reliability. It uses Python's asyncio for efficient handling of numerous simultaneous device connections and events through an event-driven architecture. You can run it on a Raspberry Pi to automate lights, sensors, and appliances via its web interface or YAML configuration, and extend functionality with custom integrations or community add-ons for personalized smart home scenarios.

items.name: prefect
items.summary: Prefect 是一个用于构建弹性数据管道的 Python 工作流编排框架。其核心优势在于支持动态、有状态的执行，并具备自动重试和失败处理机制，确保工作流的健壮性。用户只需通过装饰器将 Python 函数定义为任务，即可轻松创建复杂的工作流，并可部署为定时任务或通过 API 触发，同时享受内置的监控和可观测性功能。适用于数据工程、MLOps 等场景，帮助团队实现可靠的数据管道编排。
items.summary_en: Prefect is a Python workflow orchestration framework for building resilient data pipelines. Its key strength lies in dynamic, stateful execution with automatic retries and failure handling, making pipelines robust against failures. Use Prefect to define workflows as Python functions with decorators, then deploy them to run on schedule or via API, with built-in monitoring and observability.

items.name: Wand-Enhancer
items.summary: Wand-Enhancer 是为 WeMod 游戏修改器打造的开源增强扩展，专注于提升用户体验与互操作性。基于 C# 和 WPF 框架，它通过插件化架构实现了可定制的界面、高效的模组管理以及第三方工具集成。技术上，项目深度对接 WeMod API，支持动态加载模组和主题切换。实际使用中，玩家可安装此扩展获得更直观的模组切换、自动更新与性能监控功能；开发者则能利用其清晰的代码结构快速创建专属模组包或拓展新特性。
items.summary_en: Wand-Enhancer is an open-source extension for the WeMod game trainer app, enhancing user experience and interoperability. Built with C# and WPF, it adds customizable UI elements, improved mod management, and integration with external tools through a plugin-based architecture. Developers can fork the project to create tailored mod packs or extend functionality, while users benefit from a streamlined interface and advanced features like mod auto-updates and performance overlays.

items.name: hallmark
items.summary: Hallmark 是一套基于 CSS 的设计技巧，专门用于约束 Claude Code、Cursor 和 Codex 等 AI 编码助手，防止它们生成杂乱、不一致的“AI 废料”代码。它通过预定义的美学规则和结构化模式，引导 AI 产出更干净、更符合人类审美的样式代码。开发者可以将 Hallmark 作为自定义技能加载到这些工具中，自动应用设计约束，确保 AI 生成的 UI 代码遵循品牌规范和视觉层级。这一项目特别适合需要保证 AI 辅助前端输出一致性的团队，无需逐行人工审查，就能获得高质量的样式结果。
items.summary_en: Hallmark is a CSS-based design skill that prevents AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex from producing sloppy, inconsistent output. By enforcing a set of aesthetic rules and structured patterns, it guides AI to generate cleaner, more human-readable code. Developers can load Hallmark as a custom skill within these tools to automatically apply design constraints, ensuring that AI-generated UI code respects branding guidelines and visual hierarchy. This is ideal for teams wanting consistent front-end output from code assistants without manual review.

items.name: destructive_command_guard
items.summary: Destructive Command Guard（dcg）是一个用Rust编写的安全工具，专门防止AI智能体执行危险的git或shell命令。它通过内置的阻断规则和策略引擎，拦截强制推送、文件删除等高危操作，避免智能体误操作导致的灾难性后果。开发者可将其作为命令包装器或预提交钩子集成，适用于需要限制智能体权限的CI/CD流水线或自动化脚本场景，在保证正常功能的同时大幅提升安全性。
items.summary_en: Destructive Command Guard (dcg) is a Rust-based safety tool that prevents AI agents from executing risky git or shell commands. Its core strength is a comprehensive blocklist and policy engine that intercepts dangerous operations like forced pushes or file deletions. Developers can integrate dcg as a command wrapper or pre-commit hook, making it ideal for CI/CD pipelines or agent-driven workflows where uncontrolled commands could cause damage.

items.name: pgrust
items.summary: pgrust 是用 Rust 重写 PostgreSQL 的开源项目，已通过 100% 回归测试，确保与原始 Postgres 完全兼容。其核心优势在于利用 Rust 的内存安全和高性能特性，在保持 SQL 语义不变的同时，提升系统稳定性和运行效率。开发者可直接将其作为 Postgres 的替换方案使用，或参与贡献以优化特定工作负载，例如高并发或内存敏感场景。该项目展示了如何通过现代系统语言重写关键基础设施，既保留成熟生态又获得语言级安全保障。
items.summary_en: pgrust reimplements PostgreSQL in Rust, achieving full compatibility by passing 100% of its regression tests. This rewrite leverages Rust's memory safety and performance while preserving exact SQL semantics, making it a drop-in replacement. Developers can experiment with it as a safer, faster Postgres alternative or contribute to optimize specific workloads.

items.name: background-agents
items.summary: Background-agents 是一个开源的编码代理系统，专为在后台持续运行的自主智能体设计。它允许开发者部署长时间运行的任务，如代码审查、重构和自动修复，无需人工监督。其核心优势在于基于 TypeScript 的模块化架构和 MIT 许可，便于集成和定制工作流程。你可以将其嵌入到持续集成管线中，或作为个人编码助手，自动化日常开发中的重复性工作，从而提升团队效率，专注于更复杂的逻辑设计。
items.summary_en: Background-agents is an open-source framework for creating autonomous coding agents that run persistently in the background. It enables developers to deploy agents for tasks like code review, refactoring, and bug fixing without manual intervention. Built with TypeScript and MIT-licensed, it offers a modular architecture for custom workflows. Use it to integrate AI-powered coding assistants into your CI/CD pipeline or automate routine development tasks, freeing developers for higher-level work.

items.name: sharpemu
items.summary: sharpemu 是一个实验性 PlayStation 5 模拟器，旨在实现 PS5 游戏在 Windows 上运行。采用 C# 编写，借助 .NET 运行时稳定性与便利性，专注低层硬件模拟以提升兼容性与精度。作为开源项目，支持社区参与逆向工程与模拟技术探索。目前处于早期阶段，仅支持少量游戏基本运行，适合开发者测试学习。通过此项目可了解现代游戏机模拟挑战（如 GPU 指令翻译、系统调用重定向）。需高性能 PC 编译源码，未来有望支持更多商业游戏。
items.summary_en: sharpemu is an experimental PlayStation 5 emulator for Windows, aiming to bring PS5 games to PC through low-level emulation. Written in C#, it leverages the .NET runtime for stability and ease of development, focusing on accurate hardware simulation. As an open-source project, developers can contribute to its growing compatibility and explore PS5 reverse engineering. Currently in early stages, it offers a foundation for testing and developing PS5 emulation on consumer hardware, inviting experimentation and collaboration.

items.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
items.summary: BGE-small-en-v1.5 是一个高效的英文句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为语义丰富的向量表示，专门解决文档相似度计算和语义搜索问题。它通过对比学习结合困难负样本挖掘，并采用知识蒸馏技术从大模型中学习，在保持轻量级的同时实现了优异的性能表现。开发者可将其用于构建智能检索系统、文档聚类分析，或作为RAG架构中的编码器，特别适合部署在计算资源有限的环境中探索语义理解应用。
items.summary_en: BGE-small-en-v1.5 is a compact English sentence embedding model that converts text into meaningful numerical representations for semantic similarity tasks. It employs contrastive learning with hard negatives and knowledge distillation from larger models, achieving strong performance despite its small size. You can use it for semantic search, clustering similar documents, or as a lightweight encoder in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, making it ideal for resource-constrained applications.

items.name: gte-reranker-modernbert-base
items.summary: GTE-Reranker-ModernBERT-Base 是一个基于交叉编码器的重排序模型，旨在提升检索系统的准确性。在 RAG 或搜索场景中，它先对初检结果逐对计算查询与文档的相关性分数，从而修正粗排阶段的误差。该模型基于 ModernBERT 架构，采用了高效的注意力机制，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算开销。你只需在 Transformers 或 ONNX Runtime 中加载模型，即可将其嵌入现有系统；甚至可通过 Transformers.js 在浏览器端实现实时重排序，适合对延迟敏感的应用。典型用途包括搜索引擎、问答系统和知识库检索的排序优化。
items.summary_en: GTE-Reranker-ModernBERT-Base is a cross-encoder reranker that refines initial search results by precisely scoring query-document relevance, significantly improving retrieval accuracy in RAG pipelines. Built on ModernBERT, it leverages a modern attention mechanism and efficient architecture to achieve strong performance with lower computational cost compared to traditional BERT-based rerankers. You can easily integrate it into your retrieval system using Hugging Face's transformers or ONNX runtime, or deploy via Transformers.js for in-browser reranking.

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.name: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
items.summary: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 是一个紧凑的多语言句子编码模型，专门解决跨语言语义理解难题，支持50多种语言的文本相似度计算。它通过知识蒸馏技术将大型多语言Transformer的能力压缩到轻量级12层架构中，同时保持跨语言语义对齐特性，让模型在不同语言间准确捕捉相同含义。开发者可直接用它构建多语言语义搜索系统、实现跨语言文档分类，或作为特征提取器用于下游NLP任务，只需输入任意支持语言的文本即可获得高质量的语义向量表示。
items.summary_en: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 is a compact multilingual sentence encoder that solves the challenge of understanding semantic similarity across 50+ languages without language-specific models. It achieves this by distilling knowledge from larger multilingual transformers i…
